description: This module manages private network on Scaleway account (https://developer.scaleway.com).

parameters.name: api_timeout
parameters.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds. Default: 30

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if profile is not specified.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of api_token. It is also possible to set SCW_PROFILE to use a SCW CLI config profile.

parameters.name: query_parameters
parameters.description: List of parameters passed to the query string. Default: {}

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Scaleway region to use (for example par1). Choices: "ams1" "EMEA-NL-EVS" "ams2" "ams3" "par1" "EMEA-FR-PAR1" "par2" "EMEA-FR-PAR2" "par3" "waw1" "EMEA-PL-WAW1" "waw2" "waw3"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the VPC. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: List of tags to apply to the instance. Default: []

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create an private network
  community.general.scaleway_private_network:
    project: '{{ scw_project }}'
    name: 'vpc_one'
    state: present
    region: par1
  register: vpc_creation_task

- name: Make sure private network with name 'foo' is deleted in region par1
  community.general.scaleway_private_network:
    name: 'foo'
    state: absent
    region: par1

return_values.name: scaleway_private_network
return_values.description: Information on the VPC. Returned: success when state=present Sample: {"created_at": "2022-01-15T11:11:12.676445Z", "id": "12345678-f1e6-40ec-83e5-12345d67ed89", "name": "network", "organization_id": "a123b4cd-ef5g-678h-90i1-jk2345678l90", "project_id": "a123b4cd-ef5g-678h-90i1-jk2345678l90", "tags": ["tag1", "tag2", "tag3", "tag4", "tag5"], "updated_at": "2022-01-15T11:12:04.624837Z", "zone": "fr-par-2"}
